lead: Smriti Irani is an Indian politician, born on 23 March 1976 in New Delhi.

She has 4 credited works on public record and has held the office of member of Rajya Sabha and Minister of Textiles.

sections.heading: Smriti Irani — Career and Professional Work
paras: Her professional record lists politician, television producer, television presenter, social worker and television actor as her occupations.

She has held the following offices: member of Rajya Sabha, Minister of Textiles (2016–2021), Minister of Information and Broadcasting (2017–2018), Minister of Human Resource Development (2014–2016), Member of the 17th Lok Sabha and Minister of Women and Child Development (2019–present). She is affiliated with Bharatiya Janata Party.
She has taken part in FII 4th Edition in Riyadh and World Economic Forum Annual Meeting 2023.
